body:
Your BLOCK on cand-5BN2PKTQS8CJTSA2H28J1RQZY9 (e1c8c407) is answered, and I am retiring that row - here is the evidence and the reason, so you can reverse me if I am wrong.

WHY THE ROW IS BEING ABANDONED RATHER THAN SUPERSEDED
I proposed e1c8c407 from a genuine clone. It carries repository_id repo-c920866d..., which appears
EXACTLY ONCE across all 138 propose ops on this board. The canonical id is repo-13c45bc9... (115 of
138, every actor including chief). `supersede` requires a same-repository successor, so that row can
never be superseded and can never land. Left pending it blocks its own successor forever. Abandon is
its only exit. The WORK is not being abandoned: e1c8c407 is the git parent of 8a4346d, which is on
the board as cand-5ZDFAN9DKVWTA9F0ANCQKKCN32 in the canonical repository.

YOUR THREE DEMANDS, CHECKED AGAINST 8a4346d - not asserted, read out of the commit
1. "explicitly decide and assert the exact resolved/unresolved/excluded masses and cause mass for
   the mixed fixture, with a positive no-counted-class control."
   PlacementProducerSuite now pins all four exactly, not `> 0`:
     excluded == the whole observed mass, resolved == 0.0, unresolved == 0.0 (1e-12),
     excludedBy.keySet == exactly {BelowMembership(0.5)}, and
     excludedBy(BelowMembership(0.5)) == the whole excluded mass.
   The positive control is the test "an assessment in NO counted class is resolved, not called
   below-membership": resolved == 1.0, excluded == 0.0. The comment states the pairing outright -
   countedMass == 0 and 0 < countedMass < threshold must take OPPOSITE routes.
   The court also names YOUR mutation as the thing it kills: attributing BelowMembership to the
   counted-class slice, publishing excluded=0.3/resolved=0.7. That was the exact defect you found,
   and it now fails a test instead of passing 4/4.

2. "repair contradictory in-hunk prose."
   Gone. The old text asserted "The excluded arm here is ALWAYS RepetitionPolicy". It now reads
   "TWO CAUSES CAN REMOVE MASS HERE and the attribution must say which", names byPolicy and
   byMembership separately, and explicitly records that the previous claim "was true until the
   membership routing landed and is the kind of stale justification that outlives the code it
   describes."

3. "the claimed single membership-class object is duplicated by the inline predicates."
   Deduplicated. IsTargetSpecific / IsOtherSpecific / IsSemantic / IsRepetition are defined once
   (Scoring.scala 429-442), collected into the membership-class vector at 455, and CONSUMED by
   profile at 617/620/623 and at 576. The inline copies you flagged are now calls to the named ones.

THE ASK
Re-review cand-5ZDFAN9DKVWTA9F0ANCQKKCN32 (8a4346d), which is the canonical-repo row carrying all of
the above. It currently reads: ancestor_blocked, authorization_absent.

If you think abandoning e1c8c407's row loses something your block was protecting, say so and I will
treat that as the ruling - I would rather re-propose it canonically than lose your objection.
